# Configuration

One optional file, `config.toml`, in `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/gitterrace` or `~/.config/gitterrace` (`--config DIR` picks another folder). It is never read from a served repository. A flag beats the file, the file beats the default. Unknown keys warn, invalid values stop startup naming the key. `git terrace config` prints what is in force and where each value came from.

Per-repository overrides go under `[repo.NAME]` (the repository's folder name) and take `exclude`, a list of path globs added to `insights.exclude`.

Actions live in their own file, `actions.toml`, because they run commands.

## `[server]`

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `addr` | string | `"127.0.0.1:4242"` | Address to listen on. Keep it local: pages show source code and there is no login. |
| `max_streams` | integer | `32` | Maximum open live-update streams per repository (one per browser tab). |

## `[watch]`

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | bool | `true` | Notice new commits and refs while running. Off means a restart or a reload is needed. |
| `interval_ms` | integer | `1000` | How often to check each served repository for changes, in milliseconds. A check is a few `stat` calls. Minimum 250. |

## `[index]`

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `build_on_start` | bool | `true` | Build the commit index as soon as a repository is served: at startup for one repository, at its first visit when several share the server. Off waits for the first page that needs it (Insights). |
| `threads` | integer | `0` | Threads used to parse the index. 0 means one per core, capped at 8. |

## `[resources]`

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cache_mb` | integer | `64` | Memory for the blame and highlighted-code caches together, in MB, shared half and half. The highlighted-code cache is per process, the blame cache per repository. |
| `blocking_jobs` | integer | `0` | Most page-building git jobs running at once across all repositories. 0 means one per core. |

## `[limits]`

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text_kb` | integer | `2048` | Largest file shown as text, in KiB. Larger files are offered as raw downloads. |
| `raw_mb` | integer | `256` | Largest file served raw, in MB. |
| `search_matches` | integer | `500` | Most matches a code search returns. |
| `diff_fold_lines` | integer | `400` | Lines of one file's diff shown before it folds. |

## `[insights]`

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `exclude` | list of strings | `[]` | Paths (globs) left out of every insight. |
| `bots` | bool | `false` | Count commits by bots. |
| `generated` | bool | `false` | Count lock files and minified output. |
| `period` | string | `"all"` | Period the Pulse, Hotspots, Ownership, Patterns, Code frequency and Contributors pages use when the URL names none: 1w, 1m, 3m, 1y or all. All leaves each page its own default (Pulse opens on a month). |

## `[display]`

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `theme` | string | `"system"` | Color theme before the visitor picks one: system, light or dark. |
| `dates` | string | `"relative"` | How dates read: relative or absolute. |

## `[multi]`

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `depth` | integer | `2` | How many folder levels to search below a given folder for repositories. |
| `skip_dirs` | list of strings | `["node_modules", "target", ".wt"]` | Folder names never searched, besides hidden ones. |
